_meta.feast: Our Father Among the Saints John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople
_meta._note: OCA does not publish a Matins DOCX for this feast. Matins from St-Sergius Emenaion (yy/archaic register). Single hierarch canon by Theophanes in Tone VIII (acrostic 'I hymn thee, the golden mouth of the Spirit') — the Theotokos Paraklisis canon mentioned in the Sergius rubric is omitted per the pattern. Magnificat retained.

troparion.text:
Grace shining forth from thy mouth like a beacon hath illumined the universe,
and disclosed to the world treasures of uncovetousness,
and shown us the heights of humility;
but while instructing by Thy words, O Father John Chrysostom,//
intercede with the Word, Christ our God, to save our souls.
troparion.label: Troparion of the holy hierarch

kontakion.text:
From the heavens hast thou received grace,
and by thy lips thou dost teach all to worship the One God in Trinity,
O John Chrysostom, all blessed righteous one.//
Rightly do we acclaim thee, for thou art a teacher revealing things divine.
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy hierarch

sedalion.text:
Thou hast shone forth in splendor upon mortals like a golden star, O all-blessed John Chrysostom,
illumining the ends of the earth with the beams of thy discourses.
Wherefore, celebrating thy most holy memory today,
we ask for the remission of all our sins.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 1)

bothNow.text:
O pure Virgin Theotokos who knewest not wedlock,
thou sole intercessor and protection of the faithful:
from tribulations, sorrows and cruel circumstances deliver all who place their trust in thee,
O Maiden, and save our souls by thy divine supplications.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

sedalion.text:
O ye faithful, as is meet let us honor Chrysostom,
the meadow of discourses on the divinely inspired Scriptures,
who guideth us to repentance, and who endured manifold trials,
in that we have been taught by him;
for he prayeth to the Lord, that our souls be saved.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 2)

bothNow.text:
Awesome is the miracle of thy conceiving,
and the ineffable image of birth giving known in thee, O pure Ever-virgin,
filleth my mind with awe and amazeth my thoughts.
Thy glory hath spread over all, O Theotokos, unto the salvation of our souls.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

verses: Hear this, all ye nations; give ear, all ye that inhabit the world.
Glory… Both now… Alleluia… Glory to thee, O God!

sessionalHymns.text:
By thy divine words, O blessed Chrysostom, thou wast truly manifest as a spiritual treasury of the world,
and shining forth upon the ends of the earth,
thou hast bestowed the riches of salvation upon all, guiding the people to repentance.
Wherefore, having completed the course of thy life, thou standest before the throne of the Most High,
O ever-memorable John Chrysostom.
Entreat Christ God, that He grant remission of sins unto those who with love celebrate thy holy memory.
sessionalHymns.label: Sessional Hymn after the Polyeleios

bothNow.text:
Let us hymn the heavenly gate and ark, the most holy mountain, the cloud of light,
the heavenly ladder, the spiritual Paradise, the redemption of Eve,
the great treasure of the world;
because salvation for the world and forgiveness of ancient offences were wrought in her.
Therefore we cry unto her:
Intercede with thine own Son and God to grant forgiveness of offences//
to those who devoutly worship thine all-holy Offspring.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

prokeimenon.refrain:
My mouth shall speak wisdom,
and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
prokeimenon.verse: Hear this, all ye nations; give ear, all ye that inhabit the world.

gospel._note: I am the door of the sheep.

postGospelSticheron.text:
Grace was poured forth through thy lips, O venerable father,
and thou wast a pastor of the Church of Christ,
teaching the reason-endowed sheep to believe in the consubstantial Trinity in one Godhead.
postGospelSticheron.label: Sticheron after Psalm 50

_authors.first: Theophanes (Tone VIII; acrostic 'I hymn thee, the golden mouth of the Spirit')

canon._canonNote: Single hierarch canon. The Theotokos Paraklisis canon mentioned in the Sergius rubric is omitted per the pattern.

ode1.irmos:
The wonderworking staff of Moses,
striking and dividing the sea in the figure of a cross,
once drowned Pharaoh the pursuing charioteer,
while it saved the fleeing people of Israel as they fled on foot,
chanting a hymn unto God.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
As a most fervent preacher of repentance, O father Chrysostom,
pray to God that I may be able to repent with all my heart,
and beg thou that, through thy suffering, the wounds of mine ancient transgressions may be healed.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Receiving all the effulgence of the Holy Spirit, O venerable father,
thou wast revealed to be a most radiant pillar going before the Church and guiding it,
and a luminous cloud overshadowing the councils of the Orthodox, O all-blessed one.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: All-adorned with divers forms of grace, O divinely joyous and blessed one,
thou hast given birth to the Word of the Father Who,
in His great compassion, and in a manner past understanding and all telling, assumed flesh;
and thou didst remain an undefiled Virgin.

ode3.irmos:
O Christ fortify me on the rock of Thy commandments,
Thou who in the beginning didst establish the heavens with understanding
and didst establish the earth upon the waters,
for there is none holy save Thee, O only Lover of mankind.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Enriched by the mind of Christ, by thy pure life thou didst become an aid,
the explication and enabling of the salvation of all, O divinely inspired Chrysostom,
pouring forth salvific teachings.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Made rich by the immaterial treasures of the Spirit,
thou didst draw forth an ever-flowing stream of doctrines from the wellsprings of salvation, O venerable father,
watering all of the Churches therewith.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
With the most wise tilling of thy discourses thou didst clear the stony fields of men's souls,
O wise and God-pleasing Chrysostom,
rendering them fertile, and watering them with heavenly showers.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!

sedalenAfterOde3.text:
In a godly manner thou didst draw forth a wealth of knowledge of the ineffable wisdom,
gathering in the waters of Orthodoxy for all,
which divinely gladden the hearts of the faithful and drown, as is meet, the thoughts of infidels.
Wherefore, through the sweat of piety, thou didst show thyself to be an invincible champion of the Trinity, O John Chrysostom.
Entreat Christ God, that He grant remission of sins unto those who with love celebrate thy holy memory.
sedalenAfterOde3.label: Sessional Hymn (after Ode 3)

glory.text:
Having come to know the wisdom which is from on high and the grace of words from God,
thou didst shine forth upon all like gold in the crucible,
preaching the Holy Trinity in Unity, and shooting down the delusion of avarice with the arrows of thy words.
Wherefore, having zealously reproved the empress,
thou didst put to shame the alien thinking of Arius, O John Chrysostom.
Entreat Christ God, that He grant remission of sins unto those who with love celebrate thy holy memory.

bothNow.text:
Pondering the flames and burning of Gehenna, and the weeping and lamentation therein,
the exceedingly accursed and most bitter separation,
as well as the inheritance of the saints and their joyous assembly, O my soul,
restrain thyself and give utterance to sighs;
strive to erase the record of thy many debts with tears of compunction,
having the pure Mother of God as thine unashamed companion.
For, it is for her sake that remission of sins hast been granted to those,
who in an Orthodox manner, glorify her as the Theotokos.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

ode4.irmos:
Thou, O Lord, art my strength and Thou art my power,
Thou art my God and Thou art my joy,
Thou Who, while never leaving the bosom of Thy Father, hast visited our poverty.
Therefore with the Prophet Habbakuk I cry unto Thee,
'Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!'

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Christ Who, in that He is good, exerciseth forethought for all in His providence,
hath given thee to us, O all-blessed John Chrysostom, as another peer of the apostles,
a proclaimer of the heavenly liturgy, and a divine expounder of celestial mysteries.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Let us honor the golden John Chrysostom of golden eloquence,
who hath rendered all things golden through the golden luster of his teachings,
and hath illumined the world with his tongue, which shineth brighter than gold,
is full of light and poureth forth divine grace.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thou wast wholly the habitation of God; thou wast shown to be wholly the instrument of the Spirit,
sounding forth a divinely inspired hymn of every virtue and the cause of salvation,
and revealing the beauty of the kingdom of heaven, O all-blessed John Chrysostom.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thou didst proclaim the compassion of God, setting forth examples of repentance,
and most excellently instructing us how to avoid evils,
O most blessed, most perfect and most honored father Chrysostom,
pouring forth excellent teachings on good works.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!

ode5.irmos:
O Light never-waning, why hast Thou turned Thy face from me
and why hath the alien darkness surrounded me, wretched though I be?
But do Thou guide my steps I implore Thee
and turn me back towards the light of Thy commandments.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
We all know thee to be the most radiant beacon of the Church,
saving the souls of all, rescuing them from the jaws of death,
and guiding them to everlasting life, O ever-hymned father.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thy cheeks, full of divine scents like phials of perfume,
gladden the whole world with noetic fragrance through the distilled mystagogy of thine understandings
and the beauty of thy words, O all-wise one.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Conceiving God, thou hast given birth to the Lord, Creator and Fashioner, O pure one.
All mankind blesses thee, and the intelligent ranks of the bodiless ones glorify thee as the Mother of God.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
As a rich bestower of discourse, thou hast enriched the whole world with spiritual wisdom;
for rich grace poured forth through thy lips from on high, O hierarch.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thy sound hath gone forth into all the earth like lightning, O Chrysostom,
and the power of thy words hath sounded in all the ends of the world like a blaring trumpet.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Clad in a robe of the virtues woven from on high, O all-blessed one,
and arrayed in the beauty of thy discourses,
thou wast revealed to be the glorious confirmation of the truth.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: The Lover of mankind, Who beareth all things by His omnipotent power
arrayed Himself in the weak flesh He received from thee, O all-immaculate Virgin,
for the benefit of mankind.

kontakion.text:
From the heavens hast thou received grace,
and by thy lips thou dost teach all to worship the One God in Trinity,
O John Chrysostom, all blessed righteous one.//
Rightly do we acclaim thee, for thou art a teacher revealing things divine.
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy hierarch
kontakion.melody: He Who fulfilled His providence concerning us

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Probing the depths of the abyss of goodness and compassion,
thou didst show thyself to be the surety of salvation for those who fervently repent
and cry aloud to the Lord with all their soul: O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
As elect, venerable, guileless, a priest of the Most High, splendidly arrayed in righteousness,
O spiritually rich hierarch, thou hast been exalted,
crying out with gladness: O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O most pure one, thou didst conceive Him Who is God and Lord over all,
Whose good pleasure it was to save the human race from corruption and death.
Hymning Him as is meet, we cry: O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Using thy discourses with knowledge, O Chrysostom,
we learn what is precious in theology;
we bear as fruit the profit of good things and escape the harm of evil.
For thou hast been the common cause of our salvation,
crying aloud: Supremely exalt Christ throughout the ages!

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Thou didst reprove the youthful opposition, headstrong thought and injustice of the rulers, O venerable one,
interceding fervently for the oppressed;
and in thy loving conduct thou wast a father for orphans, widows and the poor,
crying: Supremely exalt Christ throughout the ages!

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!

ode9.irmos:
Heaven was stricken with awe, and the ends of the earth were filled with amazement,
for God hath appeared in the flesh,
and thy womb was rendered more spacious than the heavens.
Wherefore, the ranks of men and of angels
magnify thee as the Theotokos.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Truly delighting in the life for which thou didst struggle as far as thou wast able, O divinely eloquent father,
and having excelled on earth by thine angelic life and acquired the tongue of Christ and a mouth of tranquility,
pray thou that those who truly bless thee with faith may be saved.

troparia.refrain: Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
Holy Father John Chrysostom, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thou hast been shown to be a most splendid mediator between God and mortals, O most radiant one;
for thou wast revealed to be a divinely luminous lamp of grace and divine understanding
and a teacher of almsgiving.
Wherefore, O Chrysostom, with heartfelt love we now magnify thee as is meet.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!

exapostilaria.label: Exaposteilarion of the holy hierarch
exapostilaria.melody: By the Spirit in the sanctuary

exapostilaria.text:
Made steadfast by him, let us all praise the all-wise John, the trumpet-voiced preacher of repentance,
the treasure of the poor, the golden and right eloquent mouth of the Church,
the expounder of the Scriptures.
exapostilaria.label: Another Exaposteilarion (at Glory)

exapostilaria.text:
O all-immaculate Virgin, my Sovereign Lady, with the glorious Chrysostom entreat thy Son,
that those who hymn thee may be delivered from all dangers and receive everlasting good things.
For thou canst do whatsoever thou desirest, O all-holy one.
exapostilaria.label: Theotokion (at Both now)

stichera.verse: To do among them the judgment that is written: this glory shall be to all His saints. (Ps. 149:9)
stichera.text:
Thou wast a most precious vessel of the divine Spirit,
and a most sacred pastor, an angel on earth,
a pillar of the Church and a foundation of the dogmas,
a surety for sinners and the divine consolation of the penitent,
who takest thought for the poor and dost comfort the orphaned,
O John Chrysostom,//
intercessor for our souls.

stichera.verse: Praise God in His saints; praise Him in the firmament of His power. (Ps. 150:1)
stichera.text:
Thou wast a sun of great brilliance illumining the whole world with thy discourses,
O most radiant star shining forth rays of light,
which ever guide to the most tranquil haven those who are tempest-tossed upon the sea of the world
by the grace of salvation,
O golden-worded Chrysostom,//
intercessor for our souls.

stichera.verse: Praise Him for His mighty deeds; praise Him according to His exceeding greatness. (Ps. 150:2)
stichera.text:
Thou wast truly an earthly angel and a heavenly man,
a melodious nightingale, a river full of noetic waters,
a cloud pouring forth showers of understanding,
abundantly watering us all, a teacher of salvation and an aid in repentance,//
O John Chrysostom.

stichera.verse: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the psaltery and harp. (Ps. 150:3)
stichera.text:
Driven unjustly from thy flock, O venerable father, thou didst partake of tribulations
and bitter imprisonment,
wherein thou wast deemed worthy of a blessed end;
and, vanquishing the most crafty one, as a valiant spiritual athlete,
thou wast crowned by Christ with a diadem of victory, O John Chrysostom,//
intercessor for our souls.

doxastikon.text:
Having adorned the Church of God with golden words and divinely eloquent teachings,
thou didst lay up therein the spiritual riches of thy divinely imparted discourses.
Wherefore, weaving a wreath for thee with hymns, as with never-fading flowers,
the Church offereth it to thy sacred memory,
O divinely wise John, golden of both soul and tongue.
Yet as thou hast boldness, O venerable one,//
pray thou on behalf of our souls.
doxastikon.author: by Anatolius

theotokion.text:
O Sovereign Lady, accept the supplication of thy servants,
and deliver us from all want and grief.
theotokion.label: Theotokion at Both now

troparionAfterDoxology.text:
Grace shining forth from thy mouth like a beacon hath illumined the universe,
and disclosed to the world treasures of uncovetousness,
and shown us the heights of humility;
but while instructing by Thy words, O Father John Chrysostom,//
intercede with the Word, Christ our God, to save our souls.
